environment.description: Production IoT platform running on ECS Fargate. The service sits behind an AWS ALB with default configuration (no WAF attached). pgBouncer 1.19 in transaction pooling mode connects to Aurora PostgreSQL 15.4. The admin dashboard fetches HTML fragments from /api/v1/messages and injects them into the page via innerHTML. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured. IoT devices authenticate via mTLS at the network edge but the message content is not sanitized beyond the device_id regex check.

config.device_auth: mTLS at edge only, no payload validation
